_comment: Hand-labeled truth corpus for the Dictionarry HDR/DV cluster.
Pattern names refer to regular_expressions.name in the replayed DB (fetched live by build_input.py).
CF:* names are composites defined in build_input.py mirroring custom_format_conditions:
CF:Dolby Vision (Without Fallback) = WF-regex AND NOT HDR AND NOT HDR10+
CF:SDR(title-part)                 = NOT 'Basic HDR Formats' AND NOT 'Movies Anywhere'  (context: 2160p WEB-DL)
CF:HDR10 (Missing)(title-part)     = NOT HDR AND NOT HDR10+ AND NOT SDR                 (context: 2160p BluRay/Remux, group not BHDStudio)
CF:HDR (Missing)(title-part)       = 'Dolby Vision' AND NOT HDR AND NOT HDR10+ AND NOT SDR AND x265 (context: 1080p BluRay)
Titles are real-world naming conventions: Radarr QualityParserFixture.cs, TRaSH-Guides HDR CF cluster, and common P5/P7/P8 WEB-DL / hybrid remux forms.
